value.title: Watcher
value.line: Reacts to events and rebuilds from current state.

sections.name: purpose
sections.value: Reacts to events (a CI result, a new message, a file change) and acts on them. It rebuilds what it needs from current state each time rather than remembering.

sections.name: lifecycle
sections.value: May be compacted or restarted at any time, because it keeps nothing it cannot re-derive.

sections.name: keeps
sections.value: Nothing it cannot re-derive from current state.

value.text: Rebuilds from current state on each event, and keeps nothing it cannot re-derive.
